messages:
maria.rev: Heads-up: Velocity (fintech) wants to replace CompetitorX with Redwood. They need a drop-in facade, cost equivalence mapping (they bill per-size bucket), security questionnaire, and guidance for handling response deltas that affect their risk-scoring pipeline. Can presales own a runbook?
ajay.se: I'll take the facade. Plan is to keep the same external API shape and translate to /v1/completions. Risks: tokenizer length drift, default sampling params, and stop token semantics.
ravi.eng: For tokenization, expect +/- 5-15 token delta depending on language and punctuation. If their downstream scoring uses token counts or offsets, we'll need offset mapping or normalization in the facade.
lucy.solutions: Proposed POC steps: 1) collect 300 representative calls (NLU, summarization, extraction), 2) run A/B vs CompetitorX and 2 Redwood configs (standard + quantized), 3) surface major regression rate and token distribution per-band, 4) produce cost projection.
gina.security: Security checklist: SCIM/SSO, BYOK integration (AWS/GCP KMS), audit logging to their SIEM, IP allowlist, EU data residency, and SOC2 addendum. Need their compliance contact and a sample ACL/IP list.
infra-bot: Deployment note: Hosted supports temp session pin via KV headers for the POC; Dedicated/Private supports persistent KV pinning.
ajay.se: Adapter example (CompetitorX -> Redwood):
CompetitorX: POST /api/v1/respond {"prompt":"...","max_out":64,"stop":"\n\n"}
Redwood call: POST /v1/completions {"model":"redwood-gen","input":"...","max_output_tokens":64,"stop_sequences":["\n\n"]}
Note: include an output-normalizer to exact-match stop truncation for their parser.
maria.rev: Acceptance criteria suggestion: parity suite <=3% major regressions; P95 latency <750ms at their expected 120 TPS; cost projection within 12% after sampling; signed security questionnaire.
lucy.solutions: I'll assemble the parity harness and a Colab for their finance team to play with bucket->token mappings. Will include scripts to compute monthly spend from sample logs.
ravi.eng: Engineering caveat: if they rely on exact substring offsets for entity spans, tokenization diffs may break mappings. We can add heuristics (fuzzy char-map) but document limitations and include focused edgecases in tests.
gina.security: I'll start the SA doc and request their legal/compliance contact. Also need to know if they require HSM-backed keys.
ajay.se: Timeline: day 0-1 creds + security kickoff; day 2-4 build facade + smoke; day 5-7 run parity & billing samples; day 8 remediation & demo prep. Demo requested in 9 business days.
maria.rev: Great. @gina.security please loop their compliance. @ajay.se open the proxy repo and post smoke logs here. Keeping this thread as the central POC channel. :thumbsup:
